from pathlib import Path

import aspenops_nexus
from aspenops_nexus.evaluation_plan import EvaluationPlanCompiler
from aspenops_nexus.models import EvaluationRequest
from aspenops_nexus.registry import NodeRegistry

root = Path(aspenops_nexus.__file__).resolve().parent
registry = NodeRegistry(root / "data/node-registry.json")
request = EvaluationRequest.from_dict(
    {
        "model_path": str(root / "data/mock-case.json"),
        "registry_path": str(root / "data/node-registry.json"),
        "backend": "mock",
        "writes": [],
        "reads": [
            {
                "key": "stream.output.purity",
                "identifiers": {"stream": "PRODUCT"},
            }
        ],
        "constraints": [
            {
                "key": "stream.output.purity",
                "identifiers": {"stream": "PRODUCT"},
                "operator": ">=",
                "value": 0.5,
            }
        ],
    }
)
plan = EvaluationPlanCompiler.compile(registry, request)
assert plan.estimated_io.declared_reads == 2
assert plan.estimated_io.unique_read_nodes == 1
